title: Seating Arrangement Permutations
description: An event coordinator needs to arrange a group of distinct VIP guests in a single row of seats. Write a function to generate all possible seating permutations for the given guests.
constraints: All guest identifiers in the input list are unique.
input_format: A list of integers or strings representing unique VIP guests.
output_format: A list of lists containing all possible permutations of the guests.

examples.explanation: There are 2 factorial = 2 possible arrangements for two guests.
There are 3 factorial = 6 possible arrangements for three guests.
A single guest has only 1 possible arrangement.
